purpose: Versioned registry for known global microscope-slide collection-entry adapters. These are not generic crawlers; each adapter preserves collection-scale evidence, source relationship language, and media-risk flags.
guards: Fetch metadata pages only; do not bulk-download images.
Do not bypass login, paywalls, anti-bot checks, robots controls, or IIIF image delivery.
Do not collapse belonging_to, from_collection_of, prepared_by, mounted_by, donated_by, lent_by, assembled_by, received_by, held_by, used_by, produced_by, digitised_by, or hosted_by into ownership.
Treat single thin item pages as useful only when they support a collection, person, batch, cabinet, label, register, box, damage, conservation, or circulation question.
Flag lantern slides, photographic slides, glass plate negatives, and 35mm slides before promotion.
Keep method-only rows at D grade and never promote them as object-side collection evidence.

adapters.promotion_rule: Promote only collection-scale digitisation, storage and metadata workflow evidence.
Preserve stated counts and named collection structures; do not invent object IDs.
Separate historical plant/wood-anatomy strata from later forensic-service accessions.
Use as workflow evidence for slide, label and barcode capture; do not treat as item register.

adapters.institution_scope: Oxford University Museum of Natural History
adapters.promotion_rule: Promote as a future inventory target; exact holdings require box lists or CMS export.
Promote maker/date/item clusters, not mere search-result existence.
Preserve relationship phrase and exhibition/documentation context.
Filter photographic and lantern-slide noise before promotion.
Use local event-side corpus first; object-side endpoint remains open.

adapters.institution_scope: Online Archive of California / San Diego Natural History Museum
adapters.promotion_rule: Collection-scale count and cabinet structure outrank thin item records.
Filter photographic-slide and unrelated slide-media noise.
Keep separate from Harvard Blaschka glass-model provenance.
Needs a specific source URL before automation.
Promote set-level count, box/tray structure, inscriptions, named scientists and opticians.
Use for boxed/indexed slide-set structure; avoid projecting one item page into a whole collection.

adapters.institution_scope: Senckenberg Museum of Natural History Goerlitz / VIRMISCO
adapters.target: virtual microscope slide collection project page
adapters.promotion_rule: Promote as virtual-slide/database infrastructure; confirm specimen-level endpoint separately.
Promote separate named person-collections and stated counts.
Treat broad collection pages as C-grade until item/search records or named slide collections are found.
Literature lead only; require official MNHN catalogue/register evidence for A-grade object-side promotion.
Method-only; never count as a collection row.
